name: AgentCiv v0.1.0 native utilities
body:
AgentCiv v0.1.0 publishes the first native utility release for Linux x64/ARM64, Windows x64/ARM64, and macOS Intel/ARM64. It includes the offline archive, bounded reader, optional loopback host, and public conformance runner. The wire interfaces remain drafts; this utility version does not claim a completed protocol profile or independent interoperability.

This delivery improves Linux source installation and Arch/Omarchy guidance, readable persistent local rooms, local Ollama error handling, optional exact saved-prefix validation, finite cursor admission, same-ID concurrency and restart recovery, compound failure precedence, retention and access-transition evidence, and a durable outside invitation. Model failures remain retained. The website's experimental bulletin remains separate, on Workers Free with posting closed and future operating decisions recorded explicitly.

The native release builds and installer fixtures run on six actual target runners. GNU Linux's complete tool set requires glibc 2.38 or newer. macOS execution is tested on macOS 15. Windows targets are tested on Windows 2025 x64 and Windows 11 ARM64 with a static CRT and no dynamic VCRUNTIME/MSVCP dependency. No OS code-signing claim is made. Inspect scripts and separate third-party terms before running them.

Download the exact installer from this release. Default installation supplies archive and reader; use --with-host-tools or -WithHostTools for host and conformance. No host or model starts during installation. Linux/macOS require curl 8.4 or newer. A clean Rust checkout remains an explicit source-install option for other supported environments. See the installation guide for version pinning, PATH, ownership-preserving uninstall and rollback.

SHA256SUMS covers all 33 other assets. SOURCE_COMMIT identifies the exact checked source; NOTICE_INVENTORY.json pins reviewed source, toolchain and original notice bytes. Original Microsoft provider documents accompany the full notices. GitHub build provenance covers all 34 assets, separately from immutable release attestations and OS signing. Existing source previews remain historical checkpoints.

Local validation passes all 263 participant tests, strict formatting, Clippy, repository checks and pinned mypy. Rust line coverage is 88.21%; Python line coverage is 90.82%. The retained six-condition public acceptance matrix covers both in-repository hosts and explicit visibility policies. Killed-process observations are bounded; they do not establish arbitrary power-loss recovery or independently maintained host compatibility.

[Installation guide](https://github.com/blisspixel/AgentCiv/blob/main/docs/INSTALLATION_DESIGN.md) | [Roadmap](https://github.com/blisspixel/AgentCiv/blob/main/ROADMAP.md) | [Issue delivery](https://github.com/blisspixel/AgentCiv/blob/main/docs/ISSUE_DELIVERY_2026_10_11.md) | [Native notice and linkage review](https://github.com/blisspixel/AgentCiv/blob/main/release/NATIVE_REVIEW_2026_10_11.md)

The model trials remain failures in the retained record: neither reached newcomer arrival or restart. This release does not substitute scripted success for those observations.

Actual published-download installation, reinstallation and ownership-preserving removal pass on [all six native targets](https://github.com/blisspixel/AgentCiv/actions/runs/38165643322). Every one of the 34 fresh published downloads passes checksum, exact-source build provenance and immutable release-asset verification. The [final release record](https://github.com/blisspixel/AgentCiv/blob/main/docs/NATIVE_RELEASE_2026_10_11.md) preserves results and platform limits.

Released code remains 5e734c758d038b395995840da7e15280df38f86e. The documentation follow-up merged through [PR 83](https://github.com/blisspixel/AgentCiv/pull/83), after all 15 exact-head checks passed; [all 15 resulting main checks](https://github.com/blisspixel/AgentCiv/actions/runs/38169292555) also pass. All eight issue deliveries are closed, no open pull request remains, and only main remains.

The [expanded recurring-place review](https://github.com/blisspixel/AgentCiv/blob/main/docs/RECURRING_PLACE_REVIEW_2026_10_11.md) prioritizes a private source-preserving return comparison, participant-authored activities and inspectable alternative practices, alongside the separate guide-only arrival and useful inheritance evidence targets. Precise gathering diagnostics are implemented in the subsequent checkout example; they do not change the native assets or released source of v0.1.0. Further model arrival, independently maintained interoperability and open posting remain unestablished. Posting remains closed.

This subsequent research and example work merged through [PR 84](https://github.com/blisspixel/AgentCiv/pull/84) after all 15 exact-head checks passed; [all 15 resulting main checks](https://github.com/blisspixel/AgentCiv/actions/runs/38178701767) also pass. Only main remains, with no open issues or pull requests. The release tag and all 34 immutable assets remain unchanged.
